rows.en: Look at this craft… It's scorched, isn't it?

Hmm…

This is from the friction heat when it entered the atmosphere! Judging from the ship's shape, it's not from Earth, is it?
Shall we go in?

Wait, first we check our weapons! It's an enemy we haven't seen yet…

All right, let's go!
Who's there!!
Heh heh… You startled me.
I'm the one who got startled! What are you doing in a place like this?

Heh heh…

I didn't think anyone would come to a place like this. It's the perfect hideout…

(Wait a minute…

It's strange for a girl to be in a place like this, isn't it? We're deep in the mountains, and yet her shoes are this clean…)

It's dangerous for you to stay here!

You probably won't understand, but this is a spaceship that aliens came here in…
Huh…?
Ugh… Cough, cough… Sleeping… gas!

Kazami!

I figured that if I followed your movements, I'd run straight into Destron for sure… and I was right!
Yuki… Are you still saying things like that?
Leave this to me! Hmph…
Traitor Joji Yuki… no, Riderman! I'll send you to hell too!!
Look out!!
Look out!!
Waaaaagh!!

…!?

Kazami!!
Ugh… Riderman, you're the one they're after! Never mind me! Hurry up and defeat the enemy!!
Ugh… Riderman, you're the one they're after! Never mind me! Hurry up and defeat the enemy!!

…!?

Kazami, you took that for me?
Don't dawdle!
Don't dawdle!

Well now… that's reassuring!

If the Science Patrol, MAT and your Ultra Garrison, Anne, all throw their full strength into fighting the invaders, that'll be a real help to us!

I hope so…

Thank you, I'll have some.
Oyassan! Destron attacked us at Lake Azuma!
A woman named Misao and a boy named Hiroshi were taken hostage! Damn it, and I was right there with them…
Then you'd better go rescue them right away!
The thing is… I don't know where their hideout is.
Hey, hey… Aren't you forgetting somebody?
Taki… Then you…?
The FBI's intelligence network is nothing to sneeze at! All right, I'll show you the way.

Shiro…!?

What on earth happened?
I'm sorry I couldn't be of more help…

No… It's not your fault.

Kazami is a cyborg… Of course you couldn't treat him.

Besides, this is what's called a Batal Bullet, one of Destron's special weapons. It's a terrifying bullet that paralyzes a cyborg's control over his own power.
A Batal Bullet? Shiro got shot with something like that…!?
Shiro…

Yuki…

We have to rescue Misao and Hiroshi from earlier…
Mm… They must have been taken to Destron's hideout.

You really are something…

You took that bullet in my place, and even while you suffer in that body, you're worried about those people…

I'm so sorry… I'm the one who should be suffering! I'll fix your body! I'll fix it for sure… Just wait for me!
(Damn… I can't control my power. What am I supposed to do? What can I…!?)
Shiro… can you play the guitar?
Shiro… you play the guitar, right?

Oh, that's right…

If you can play the guitar, you ought to be able to control your power too! Give it a try, Shiro…
Oh, Shiro…
Shiro! That's it, keep it up… See? You can do it if you try!

…………

I'm sorry, Jiro. I broke your precious guitar! I knew it, I'm just…
Shiro! Wait a minute! Shiroooo!!
Shiro…

Oyassan!!

You mustn't touch me… I can't… control my power!
What's gotten into you, Shiro?
Right now, I don't know what to do… I don't know what I should do!!

Shiro… Don't go losing heart! Don't you ever say a thing like that, not even if your mouth is torn open!

When things are hard for you, they're hard for me too! This pain is the pain of protecting justice!
Oyassan…
Kazami… So you were here?
Yuki… Isn't there any way to fix Shiro's body?

I can fix it…

But… I found out that the equipment needed exists in only one place.
Where is that?
Destron's hideout.
Destron's hideout?
Let's go! To that Destron hideout… We have to rescue Misao and Hiroshi too.
Don't be ridiculous!? You can't, not in that condition!

No… I can't run away!

My body isn't mine alone! The happiness of people all over Japan… no, all over the world, is riding on it! Yuki, please!

Kazami…

All right… I'll lead you to Destron's hideout!

Boy… that sleeping gas really did a number on us.

Come to think of it… where did that drifter go?

Mm… I'm glad you're safe!

But the kaiju got away from us. Most likely…
Gentlemen, allow me to introduce him! Starting today, he'll be taking up his duties right away as a member of the Ultra Garrison…
I'm Dan Moroboshi. I look forward to working with you!

Ahh… You!? The drifter!

I see… So that's how it was!

Yes, Ultra Garrison here… What!?

A giant kaiju came out of the lake?

The location is… Lake Azuma in the Kiso Valley, right?

Captain, another kaiju has appeared!!
All right… This time we finish it off! Prepare to sortie at once!!
Waaaaagh!!

All right, if it's come to this…

…!?

My Ultra Eye is gone! Who could have…?

The enemy must know who I really am, and stolen my secret Ultra Eye!

Who could it be? A fearsome foe… I must get it back no matter what. The Ultra Eye is my life!

That's it! That spaceship! Damn…
Waaaaagh!!
All craft, commence attack!!
Damn… It showed up again, huh?

uncertain: U07085: [ja] rendered "your Ultra Garrison, Anne" (Tachibana addressing Anne).
U07096: 改造人間 rendered "cyborg"; "his own power" assumes the generic cyborg is male (it refers to Kazami).
U07099/U07122: ミサオさん/ヒロシ君 honorifics dropped.
U07100: speaker is "Jiro" but the line fits Joji Yuki; translated as given.
U07134: narration-kind row continues Dan's line from U07133; translated as his speech.
